newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Brazil Refripar maintained.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Brazil Refripar maintained.

text.p: -- Fator Securities said it was maintaining its buy rating on Brazilian home appliance manufacturer Refripar.
-- The recommendation is based on the company's recent restructuring, which led to an increase in sales of about $200 million, it said in a report.
-- For 1997, Fator expects Refripar's sales volume to grow six percent and exports to total between $20 million and $25 million, it added.

-- Between January and September this year, the company's sales volume grew 29.3 percent when compared with the same period last year, resulting in a 42.2 percent increase in revenues, the report said.
